releases.notes:
Cryptic 0.92.3 for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin).

Drop `cryptic-0.92.3-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove any older Cryptic jar, or let Update Checker install it. Your settings carry over.

Two new modules, prices in tooltips, a lot more Bazaar, and a Capes crash fixed.

## Before you start
- **Capes crash fixed.** In 0.87.0, Capes could crash the game on Hypixel when it met a fake player with a space in its name. If you turned Capes on, update.
- **Spirit Leap Features' leap count** moved to Positional Messages: `/cryptic posmsg leapcount <1-4|off> <message>` counts teammates in that message's spot. Its Assume core and Assume split EE2 options are gone.
- **Hidden Mobs** no longer boxes Fels and Shadow Assassins. Revealing them is unchanged.
- **Nucleus Features:** the Jungle Temple waypoints set themselves from the door guardian. The Calculate waypoints button only shows with that turned off.

## New modules
- **Farming:**
  - A visitor list beside visitor and Bazaar menus: what your visitors want, grouped, and how many you're short counting your inventory and sacks. Click an item to open it on the Bazaar.
  - Visitor amounts on buy orders and instant buys, with and without your sacks.
  - Mousemat presets beside the mousemat's sign: click a crop to write its yaw and pitch.
  - A vacuum solver that follows the vacuum's trail to the pest, and pest tracers (Semi-legit).
- **Auction House:** notifications when your auctions sell or you're outbid, optionally for your own bids, buys and listings, and for your co-op's auctions. Item names are in their rarity colour.

## Tooltips and prices
- **Tooltip Features** adds Lowest BIN, 3 Day Avg. Price and an estimated item value, with the numbers lined up in one column.
- The estimate counts books, stars, master stars, gemstones and slots, enchantments (including upgrade items like the Gold Bottle Cap), scrolls, runes, dyes, skins, rod parts and reforge stones. Hold Shift for the breakdown.
- **Counted as:** Market value (what it would sell for, as Skyblocker counts it) or Rebuild cost (what making it again costs, as SkyHanni counts it).
- Bazaar items no longer show auction lines.
- **Shift scrolls sideways** is now its own toggle, off by default, so Shift is free for the breakdown.
- **Item Protection**'s "Valuable items" rule uses the estimated value.

## Bazaar
- **Amount presets** beside "How many do you want?" and instant buys: your own amounts, the most your purse allows, and **Last order** when relisting a cancelled buy order (what hadn't filled).
- **Orders breakdown** beside Bazaar Orders: each order's worth, what your sell offers bring once they fill (after tax), and what your buy orders cost.
- Co-op fills now notify, with a toggle for co-op members' orders. Item names in notifications are in their rarity colour.

## Slayer
- **Custom laser** for Voidgloom's laser phase: each direction drawn as a filled wall in your colour instead of Minecraft's guardian beams and their bubbles. Only on the End island.
- The fight timer is read from the boss's despawn countdown, to the millisecond.

## Fishing and Crystal Hollows
- **Fishing:** a Hotspot Radar guess that follows the radar's trail to the hotspot.
- **Nucleus Features:** a crystal slot in the Nucleus can no longer be taken for a crystal's spot. The Wishing Compass target is always marked.

## Fixes
- Menus no longer lag with many protected items: the padlock was costing up to half a frame.
- The **Experimentation Table** no longer stalls when you're tabbed out between games.
- The **duplicate class alert** only counts players in the current run.
- **Current chat** remembers your channel between sessions, as Hypixel does, and now sits in front of what you type ("Party: "). Channel tabs and the prefix only show on Hypixel.
- **Custom Wither Cloak** only switches on for your own Creeper Veil, so Dwarven Mines ghosts keep their glow.

releases.notes:
Cryptic 0.87.0 for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin).

Drop `cryptic-0.87.0-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove any older Cryptic jar, or let Update Checker install it if you have automatic updates on. Your settings carry over, including through the renames and merges below.

This is the biggest update so far: everything since 0.34.1, with 21 new modules.

## Before you start
- **Client Restrictions** (Settings) is new. It switches between **Legit**, **Semi-legit** and **Cheats**, and starts on Cheats, so nothing is hidden until you choose. Anything above your mode is hidden and off, and comes back with its settings when you allow it again.
- **Renamed:** Spirit Bear is now **F4/M4 Features**, Livid Solver **F5/M5 Features**, F7/M7 QOL **F7/M7 Features**, Spirit Leap Overlay **Spirit Leap Features**, Nucleus QoL **Nucleus Features**, Scrollable Tooltips **Tooltip Features** and Etherwarp Customization **Teleport Features**.
- **Merged:** Arrow Fix, Arrow Hit Sound and Arrow Hitboxes are now one **Bow Tweaks** card.
- **Moved:** the Fire Freeze timer left Smart Tick Timer for the new **F3/M3 Features**.
- The managers (Alias, Carry, Crosshair, Keybinds, Sound) now sit in the General tab.

## New modules
- **Party Finder:** Hypixel's party finder redrawn as cards with faces, classes, levels and notes. It has search, its own Search Settings and Create Party pages, and hides the "Creating instance" screen. Parties you can't join are dimmed, or hidden.
- **Party Blacklist:** players you won't play with, kicked on join with your reason. Manage it with `/cryptic blacklist`.
- **Class Abilities:** keys for your ultimate and class ability, and a Guided Sheep timer.
- **Wither Dragons** and **Relics** (M7): spawn timers and alerts, priority tracer and split, arrow-stack aim, kill stats, relic cauldron boxes and place times.
- **F3/M3 Features:** the Fire Freeze timer, now on its own HUD element, and each Guardian's health written large on it.
- **Slayer Features:** Voidgloom phase, hits, laser and health at the boss's feet, kill times for your boss and your clients', beacon and skull highlights, and a Fire Veil ring.
- **Bazaar:** order standing (top, matched, undercut, filled) in the menu and as a HUD, alerts and sounds, reopening cancelled orders, a daily limit counter and an escrow fix.
- **Item Protection:** protect an item or a whole item type, plus rules (starred, recombobulated, worth over X). It blocks dropping, selling, salvaging and trading them, with an override key.
- **Mining:** pickaxe ability timer and alert, Pickobulus overlay, ping-offset mining with a tick counter, and a break-reset fix.
- **Fishing:** hotspot rings in the perk's colour, bobber-in-hotspot display, found and gone messages, and hiding the hotspot particles.
- **Chocolate Factory:** cookie clicking, strays, Time Tower and best-upgrade buying, egg waypoints, and muting the eating sound.
- **Item Outline:** outlines your held item (Sharp, Glow, Smooth, Square), overlay effects from tint to an enchantment glint in your colour, sparkles and particles, dropped items too.
- **Capes:** OptiFine, LabyMod and MinecraftCapes capes on other players, and a custom cape from your own image.
- **Hide Armor**, **Freelook**, **Freecam** (Cheats) and **Confirm Disconnect**.
- **Client Restrictions**, **HUD Editor** and **Credits** cards in Settings.

## Dungeons
- **Dungeon Map:** a new **Share secrets through Odin** switch (off by default). It shares room secret counts with teammates through Odin's relay, so Odin and Cryptic users see each other's. It sends your name and the lobby's server id to Odin's server.
- **Room secret counter:** no more overcount walking between rooms with the same total, the count only goes up, and a green check fills it.
- **Secrets:** Candycomb now counts as a secret item. Auto close chest can wait until you move.

...

Cryptic 0.34.1 for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin).

Drop `cryptic-0.34.1-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove any older Cryptic jar, or let Update Checker install it if you have automatic updates on. Your settings carry over.

## Nucleus QoL
- **Crystal Hollows map:** a map of the Hollows on your HUD, from Skyblocker's Crystals HUD, showing where you are and the places found this lobby. Move and resize it in the HUD editor.
- **Places** are found from the sidebar as you walk in, pinned down by lines only said there (the Kalhuiki Door Guardian, King Yolkar, a crystal being found…), picked up from coordinates other players post with a place's name, and, with Skyblocker installed, read from Skyblocker, including the places its users share. Cryptic doesn't connect to Skyblocker's server itself.
- **Labels in the world:** each place found is named with its distance.
- **Missing Crystals:** which crystals are still to be placed in the nucleus, from the Crystals widget in your tab list (add it with `/widget`).
  - *Minimalistic* shows a 💎 in each crystal's colour for every crystal you haven't found yet.
  - *Normal* writes each one out, including "Found, place it".
  - It sits under the map or as its own HUD element, and disappears once every crystal is placed.
- The crystal areas on the map and in the world use the crystal colours you've set in Nucleus QoL.

## Crosshair Editor
- **Hide the default crosshair** (on by default): only your own crosshair is drawn, whether the default comes from Minecraft or a resource pack. Turn it off to keep both.

## Daily Rewards
- Clicking claim at the Delivery Man now opens the picker by itself. Before, Hypixel closing its menu took the picker with it and you had to use `/cryptic reward`.

Auto GFS, Auto Requeue, Aliases, Keybinds, Experiment Solver and Talk before they load send commands or clicks on your behalf; use them knowing that.

Cryptic 0.33.4 for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin).

Drop `cryptic-0.33.4-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove any older Cryptic jar, or let Update Checker install it if you have automatic updates on. Your settings carry over.

## Daily Rewards (new)
Claim Hypixel's daily reward without leaving the game. When the Delivery Man sends you the reward link, Cryptic reads it and shows your three cards in its own picker, styled like the menu.
- **Turning cards:** one at a time, all at once, or already turned over when the picker opens. Press 1, 2 or 3 to turn over or claim a card.
- Each card shows its rarity in Hypixel's colours, an item icon, the amount and what it is. The rarest one glows.
- Your daily streak and best streak, with the nine-step bar.
- Hypixel's ad is waited out before you can claim, when it can't be skipped.
- **Options:** open the picker automatically, hide Hypixel's book, sounds, and close the picker once you've claimed.
- **Reminder:** a notification on Hypixel while today's reward is unclaimed, once when you join or every so often.
- `/cryptic reward` reopens the last reward if you closed it before claiming. **Preview the picker** in its settings shows it with sample cards any day.
- Links other players paste in chat are ignored, so you can't claim someone else's reward.

It ships turned on, closing after a claim and reminding once per join.

## Nucleus QoL
- **Location:** the sidebar's area line is read the way Skyblocker reads it, so the Mines of Divan, Jungle Temple, Goblin Queen's Den, Lost Precursor City and Khazad-dûm are recognised.
- **Metal Detector:** only works in the Mines of Divan, so its line no longer follows you around the Hollows. It uses a reading once it repeats with you standing still, keeps narrowing down, and rechecks its answer, which fixes it pointing at the wrong spot. The treasure stays marked until you dig it up, even if you leave and come back. When two places are left, a notification says to move a little. New look options: outline, fill or both, colours, phase, tracer and distance label.
- **All tools alert:** counts every tool the chat says you found, including ones that went to your stash. A separate alert says when your inventory is full.
- **Mole pet reminder** when you walk into the Mines of Divan without your Mole, or a note if your tab list has no Pet widget to read it from.
- **Treasure chests:** no longer confused with the Metal Detector's chest in the mines, and let go of as soon as they're lockpicked. New options: outline, fill or both, colours, phase and tracer. The HUD timer is gone.
- **Crystals outside the nucleus** are outlined by the 11 × 13 × 11 space of barriers they sit in, remembered for the lobby.

## Booster Cookie Reminder
- Checks every lobby you join and warns when you have no cookie.
- Hypixel's last-minute warning starts a countdown toast that stays up until the cookie runs out, then a toast says it has.

## Menu
- Expanded rows stay open when you close and reopen the menu on a module.
- The mouse's back button goes back from a module page.

## For testing
`/cryptic debug reward`, `block`, `sounds`, `barriers` and `hollows`. See `docs/debug-commands.md`.

Auto GFS, Auto Requeue, Aliases, Keybinds, Experiment Solver and Talk before they load send commands or clicks on your behalf; use them knowing that.

> [!WARNING]
> This release has known bugs that will be fixed soon. A lot changed at once (a whole new menu among other things), and several features have only been tested outside a real lobby or run.

Cryptic 0.32.0 for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API and Fabric Language Kotlin). Cryptic no longer needs OpenGL: everything, menus included, now works on Vulkan too.

Drop `cryptic-0.32.0-26.2.jar` into your `mods` folder and remove any older Cryptic jar. Your settings carry over.

## New menu
- A card menu in the style of Lunar and Badlion, drawn through Minecraft's own renderer instead of ImGui. The jar went from 12.8 MB to 2.4 MB.
- Poppins text and Font Awesome icons, sharp at any resolution, with its own icon for every module and the new Cryptic logo.
- **Favourites** (the star on each card), **search** on the tab row, and **Edit HUD**, **Settings** and **close** buttons in the corner.
- **Module pages:** right-click a card (or click its ⋮) to open its settings, with descriptions shown under every setting. Right-click a row to open it, left-click a toggle's row to flip it.
- A colour picker, text fields that select, copy and paste like normal ones, a draggable scrollbar, soft fades at the edges of every list, and the menu remembers where you were scrolled.
- **Background blur** with its own strength slider, independent of Minecraft's blur setting.
- The Carry, Sound, Keybinds, Alias, Crosshair and Profile managers now live on their modules' pages. The old menu, `/cryptic classic` and the Tooltips module are gone.

## Notifications
- Redesigned after Essential's: coloured titles, player faces, a timer bar that pauses on hover, and a click or drag to dismiss.
- `/cryptic debug toast` to preview them.

## Update Checker
- **Install updates automatically** (off by default): downloads the newest release built for your Minecraft version, checks it, and swaps it in after you close the game.

## Nucleus QoL
- **Metal Detector solver** (from SkyHanni): finds the Mines of Divan treasure from the detector's distance and draws it with a line from your crosshair.
- **Treasure chest helper** (from SkyHanni's Powder Chest Timer): highlights uncovered chests with the time they have left, lines them up, shows a HUD timer, and can mute the chest sounds. Keeps Skyblocker's lock pick helper.
- **Crystal slots** (from SkyHanni): boxes the five crystal slots in the Crystal Nucleus in each crystal's colour.
- **Crystals to pick up:** an experimental highlight. If it misses a crystal, stand next to it and run `/cryptic debug crystals`.

## Spirit Leap Overlay
- **Leap rotate fix** and **Boss enter rotate fix** (from RSM): after a leap you face the way your teammate does, and on entering a boss room you face into it.
- **Announce leaps** replaces the Leap Message module; your message carries over.

## Other changes
- **Block Overlay:** an **Advanced** mode from Custom Block Highlight (collision shapes, cut corners, gradients, rainbow, glide and fade).
- **F7/M7 QOL:** Maxor crystal titles, spawn timer, place timer with personal bests, and an unplaced crystal alert (from NoammAddons).
- **Class Colors:** boxes around teammates in their class colours.
- **Croesus Helper:** remembers which runs were worth a key across sessions.
- **Sounds:** every sound dropdown takes a **Custom** sound ID, with suggestions as you type.
- **Better Chat:** abbreviates "Party >" and "Guild >". **Alerts:** each alert has its own text.
- **Animations:** swing speed can apply to the empty hand. **Arrow Hitboxes:** outline, fill or both.
- **Blood Camp:** predictions measured from the mob's real position, fixing half-block-off boxes.
- **Teleport maze:** reads the pad you're on correctly and avoids the pad you just landed on.
- **Party Features:** a `!dt` after a run counts as a break straight away.
- **Terminal Simulator:** Esc goes back to the picker, and practice PBs can be reset.
